description: This file declares bindings for loading and rendering 3D models (specifically OBJ files) within a Lua scripting environment, defining function interfaces for model loading and rendering.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads a 3D model from a given file path, supporting OBJ files, into the Lua environment.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Renders a previously loaded 3D model within the Lua scripting context.
